eventDetail.scope: The main purpose of the event is to bring together professionals and students working in the multidisciplinary area of the Internet of Things (IoT), presenting and discussing their work, results and applications.  The event aims to attract people from several states in Brazil and from other countries, members of academia, research institutes and companies. The Symposium will have a focus on recent research results in the area of IoT, covering all technical aspects and applications.
